Corn is a field crop unlocked at experience level 2.

It is the second crop unlocked in the game and is used to make several food products, notably popcorn and feed for chickens and cows.

Due to its short production time, corn is often used to farm experience points or get supplies, much like wheat.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 110 coin.

Growing corn

Corn is grown in fields by planting another corn plant (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 1 xp point, and takes 5 minutes to mature.

Selling corn

  • Corn can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 72 coin for 10 units.

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for 50 to 102 corn per crate, up to a total of 408 per boat.
  • Each unit of corn gives players 2 coins and 2 experience points in boat orders.

Strategy tips

  • Corn is so common that selling it at high prices may result in fewer or slower sales.
  • Corn can always be found in the Daily Dirt.
  • Recipes ask for one to four units of corn. If you make lots of popcorn or have many farm animals, make sure you always have enough of it.
  • Corn bread is used to make tacos, fish tacos, and onion melts.
  • Wheating is always preferred over CORNING as corn takes 5 min and won't get sold quickly if you are selling at a high price, however, wheat gets sold more often, even at a high price.
  • Visitors in your farm pay only 28 per 10 corn. Even during events where they pay double, this will be lower than the maximum price in the Roadside Shop.

Did you know

  • Corn is indirectly required to make the most amount of products: 109, nearly half.
    • This is because it's required to make both Chicken, and Cow Feed, which means it's required to get Eggs, and Milk, which are key ingredients in most recipes.
